x-m-el-cul-01.title: Kaarka amaahda runtii ma yahay "saamiga dahabka"?
x-m-el-cul-01.topic: Saami, isku-simanaan iyo qaabab fanka iyo nolosha maalinlaha ah
x-m-el-cul-01.goal: Xisaabi saamiyada oo ku barbar dhig sheegasho, oo dhig halbeeg adigu leedahay oo ah inta farqi ee aad oggolaanayso intaadan isticmaalin erayada "waa saamiga dahabka."
x-m-el-cul-01.material: Qoraal blog ah ayaa leh jumladdan: 'Kaarka amaahdu waa leydi 85.6mm ku 53.98mm ah, saamiga dhinaca dheer ee dhinaca gaaban uu yahay saamiga dahabka.' Saamiga dahabku waa (1 oo lagu daray xididka labajibbaaran ee 5) loo qaybiyay 2, taasoo ah ku dhawaad 1.618. Cabbirrada (dhinaca dheer : dhinaca gaaban) ee kiisaska la barbar dhigayo waa kuwan. Warqadda A4 297mm : 210mm, kaarka boostada 148mm : 100mm, iyo shaashadda kombiyuutarka oo leh saami 16 ilaa 10, 16 : 10.
x-m-el-cul-01.thinking.0: Qiimee sheegasho adigoo isticmaalaya caddayn (saamiyada la xisaabiyay)
x-m-el-cul-01.prereq.0: Helidda saamiga labada dherer ee qaybinta (heerka dugsiga dhexe)
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.prompt: Waxaad rabtaa inaad qiimeyso jumladda blog-ka 'Kaarka amaahdu waa leydi saamiga dahabka.' Qaybi dhinaca dheer dhinaca gaaban oo dooro qiimeynta ugu fiican.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.hint.0: Qaybi dhinaca dheer dhinaca gaaban oo qiimahaas ku dhig 1.618 agtiisa.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.hint.1: Si gooni ah uga fikir haddii labada qiime ay "siman" yihiin iyo "inta ay ku kala duwan yihiin."
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.a: Qaybintu 1.586 waxay u soo koobmaysaa 1.6, sidaas darteed waxaad odhan kartaa waa saamiga dahabka saxda ah
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad u isticmaaleysaa qiime la soo koobay si u eg isku mid sida caddayn "siman." Hubi in gabagabadu isbeddelayso iyadoo ku xidhan inta lambar ee la soo koobay.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.b: 1.586 iyo 1.618 way kala duwan yihiin, sidaas darteed kaarka amaahdu xiriir kuma laha saamiga dahabka gabi ahaanba
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad u kala qaybinaysaa "siman / gabi ahaanba maya" oo keliya. Ma tixgelin inta weyn ee farqigu yahay.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.c: Saamigu waa ku dhawaad 1.586, kaas oo ka duwan 1.618, sidaas darteed 'ku dhow' waa erayga sax ah
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad barbar dhigtay qiimaha la xisaabiyay iyo qiimaha sheegashada, oo waxaad kala saartay 'siman' iyo 'ku dhow'.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.o.d: Saamiga lagu cabbiray mm wuu is beddelaa marka loo beddelo cm, sidaas darteed qiimayaasha lama barbar dhigi karo
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad u malaynaysaa saamigu inuu is beddelo marka cutubka is beddelo. Hubi waxa dhaca saamiga labada dherer ee isla cutubka lagu cabbiray marka cutubka la beddelo.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s1.explain: 85.6÷53.98 waa ku dhawaad 1.586, kaas oo ka duwan saamiga dahabka 1.618 ku dhawaad 2%. Kiis sidan oo kale ah, "ku dhow saamiga dahabka" waa odhaah daacad ah, halkii "saamiga dahabka saxda ah."
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.prompt: Waxaad dejisay halbeegga: 'Haddii dhinaca dheer ÷ dhinaca gaaban uu ka duwan yahay 1.618 gudaha 3%, waa ku dhow saamiga dahabka.' Dooro dhammaan kiisaska loo yeedhi karo ku dhow. (3% ee 1.618 waa ku dhawaad 0.049.)
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.hint.0: U beddel saamiga kiis kasta tobanle.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ka jar 0.049 1.618 oo ku dar 0.049 si aad naftaada u hesho dhexda la oggol yahay, kadibna hubi haddii saami kasta uu ku dhacayo gudaheeda.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.a: Mar kale hubi sida aad u akhrisay farqiga tallaabada helista saamiga iyo barbar dhigga halbeegga. Xisaabi haddii farqiga qiimahan iyo 1.618 uu ku jiro xadka la oggol yahay.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.b: Waxaad heshay saamiga oo waxaad barbar dhigtay farqiga 1.618 iyo xadka la oggol yahay.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.c: Hubi haddii aad naftaada u xisaabisay farqiga saamiga kaarka boostada iyo 1.618 ee ku jira xadka la oggol yahay. Dareen ah inay isu eg yihiin indhaha waa ka duwan yahay barbar dhigga halbeegga.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.r.d: Waxaad 16÷10 u beddeshay tobanle oo waxaad ku barbar dhigtay halbeegga.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s2.explain: Kaarka amaahda oo keliya, 1.586 (farqi ku dhawaad 2.0%), iyo shaashadda, 1.6 (ku dhawaad 1.1%), ayaa ku jira gudaha 3%. A4 waa ku dhawaad 1.414 (ku dhawaad 12.6%) kaarka boostaduna waa 1.48 (ku dhawaad 8.5%), xadka dibadiisa.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.prompt: Dulqaadku (halkan 3%) waa halbeeg aan dejiyay. Ku qor hal ama laba jumladood sababta ay lagama maarmaanka tahay inaad dejiso dulqaadka intaadan odhan "waa saamiga dahabka," iyo waxa ay tahay in laga digtoonaado marka la dejinayo halbeegga.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore ku qor hal jumlad sababta xukun aan halbeeg lahayn uu dhibaato u yahay.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.hint.1: Qiyaas waxa dhaca A4 iyo kaarka boostada haddii aad halbeegga u dejiso mid aad u weyn (tusaale ahaan, 20%).
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma bixisay sabab ah in qiime "saxda ah isku mid" uu ku dhawaad weligiis aan jirin dhabta ah?
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma qortay waxa dhaca haddii halbeeggu aad u weyn yahay ama aad u yar yahay?
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegi kartaa sida kaarka amaahda iyo kaarka boostada isaga kala baxaan halbeeggaaga hoostiisa?
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.model.0: Qiyaasaha la cabbiray had iyo jeer waxay leeyihiin qalad iyo xukumayaashu ma saxna, sidaas darteed qiimayaal saxda ah isku mid ah ku dhawaad ma jiraan. Sidaas darteed marka hore dhig dulqaad sida 1% ama 3%, oo dheh waa ku dhow haddii uu ku jiro gudaha. Haddii halbeegga aad u weyneyso, ku dhawaad leydi kasta wuxuu noqonayaa saamiga dahabka.
x-m-el-cul-01.s.s3.model.1: Leydi saxda ah 1.618 ku dhawaad ma jiro dhabta ah, sidaas darteed waa inaad dhigtaa xad sida gudaha 5%. Laakiin haddii aad xadka ka dhigto 10%, kaarka boostada (farqi ku dhawaad 8.5%) ayaa sidoo kale ku jira halbeeggana aad buu u dabacsan yahay.

x-m-el-cul-02.topic: Saami, isku-simanaan iyo qaabab fanka iyo nolosha maalinlaha ah
x-m-el-cul-02.title: Helidda safka khaldan ee shaxda isku-simanaanta
x-m-el-cul-02.goal: Hel oo sax khaladka xalka wadarta tirada xarriiqyada isku-simanaanta, oo naftaada u dooro qaababka leh 2 xarriiq isku-simanaan saxda ah.
x-m-el-cul-02.material: Isku-simanaanta waxaa inta badan loo isticmaalaa qaababka dhaqanka iyo naqshadda dhismaha. Arday ayaa sameeyay shax oo soo koobaya isku-simanaanta qaababka. Qaab isku-simanaan xarriiq leh wuxuu leeyahay xarriiq isku-simanaan, xarriiq ay qaabku si sax ah isu dul dhigmaan marka la laablo, qaab isku-simanaan barta ah na waa qaab isku dul dhaca asalkiisa marka la rogo bar-wareeg (180°) bar ka mid ah. Mid ka mid ah safafka shaxda wuxuu leeyahay qalad.
x-m-el-cul-02.thinking.0: Hel meesha khaladka xalku ku jiro
x-m-el-cul-02.thinking.1: Sax khaladka oo sharax sida loo hubiyo
x-m-el-cul-02.prereq.0: Macnaha qaababka isku-simanaan xarriiq leh (isu dul dhaca marka loo laablo xarriiq) iyo qaababka isku-simanaan barta ah (isu dul dhaca marka la rogo 180° bar ku wareegsan)
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka shaxda ee leh nuxur khaldan.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.hint.0: Qiyaas laabidda qaabka saf kasta warqad oo tiri xarriiqyada isku-simanaanta mid mid.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ha ka shakiyin hal saf oo keliya sababtoo ah wuxuu leeyahay xarriiqyo isku-simanaan badan; saf kasta hubi haddii qaabku runtii isu dul dhigmayo marka la laablo.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.line.0: Seddex-geesood dhinac-siman: wuxuu leeyahay 3 xarriiq isku-simanaan oo ma aha qaab isku-simanaan barta ah.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.line.1: Laba-jibbaaran: wuxuu leeyahay 4 xarriiq isku-simanaan oo waa qaab isku-simanaan barta ah.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.line.2: Leydi (ma aha laba-jibbaaran): 2 xarriiq oo dhinacyada dhererka iyo ballaadhka ah iyo labada xariiq-dhexaad, 4 gebi ahaan, waa xarriiqyo isku-simanaan, oo waa qaab isku-simanaan barta ah.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.line.3: Isu-dhigma-dhinac (ma aha leydi ama rombo): ma leh xarriiqyo isku-simanaan, oo waa qaab isku-simanaan barta ah.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.line.4: Shan-geesood joogto ah: wuxuu leeyahay 5 xarriiq isku-simanaan oo ma aha qaab isku-simanaan barta ah.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s1.explain: Safka 3 waa khalad. Haddii aad laabto leydi aan laba-jibbaaran ahayn xariiq-dhexaad, dhinaca dheer wuxuu u dhaafayaa dhinaca gaaban oo geesaha isu dul ma dhigmaan. Wuxuu leeyahay 2 xarriiq isku-simanaan oo keliya, kuwa dhex-laabasho dhererka iyo ballaadhka. Qaybta leh waa qaab isku-simanaan barta ah waa sax.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s2.prompt: Sax waxa safka 3 sheegayo, oo qor sida loo hubiyo in xariiq-dhexaad uusan ahayn xarriiq isku-simanaan qaabkaas.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir halka dhinaca dheer iyo dhinaca gaaban ay aadayaan marka aad laabto warqad leydi ah xariiq-dhexaad.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s2.hint.1: Barbar dhig laabidda xariiq-dhexaad iyo kiiska laba-jibbaaran.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma sheegtay in tirada la saxay ay tahay 2 iyo jihada xarriiqyadu aadayaan?
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma sharaxday, adigoo isticmaalaya dhererrada dhinacyada ama geesaha, sababta laabidda xariiq-dhexaad aysan isu dul dhigmin?
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma kala saartay kan iyo sababta xariiq-dhexaadyada laba-jibbaaran ay u yihiin xarriiqyo isku-simanaan?
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s2.model.0: Leydi wuxuu leeyahay 2 xarriiq isku-simanaan. Haddii aad ku laabto xariiq-dhexaad, dhinaca dheer wuxuu jiifaa dhinaca gaaban, sidaas darteed geesuhu isu dul ma dhigmaan.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s2.model.1: Waxaa jira laba xarriiq isku-simanaan oo keliya, dhex-laabasho dherer ahaan iyo ballaadh ahaan. Haddii aad ku laabto xariiq-dhexaad, hal seddex-geesood kan kale ma dul jiifo. Waa sababtoo ah dhererrada dhinacyadu way kala duwan yihiin.

x-m-el-cul-02.s.s3.hint.0: Sawir dhammaan xarriiqyada qaab kasta ay isu dul dhigmayso marka la laablo.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s3.hint.1: Barbar dhig halka xarriiqyada isku-simanaanta ay maraan leydi iyo rombo.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s3.r.a: Kani waa natiijada tirinta xarriiqyada isku-simanaanta adigoo laablaya.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s3.r.b: Mar kale laab si aad u tiriso inta xarriiq isku-simanaan ee qaabkani leeyahay. Ka fikir xarriiqda xagalka sare marta oo keliya.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s3.r.c: Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad isku qaldday sifada isku-simanaanta barta iyo sifada isku-simanaanta xarriiqda. Si gooni ah ugu hubi laabidda haddii isu dul dhigmayso.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s3.r.d: Kani waa qaab labadiisa xariiq-dhexaad ay yihiin xarriiqyo isku-simanaan. Waa natiijada tirinta adigoo kala saaraya isku-simanaanta barta iyo isku-simanaanta xarriiqda.
x-m-el-cul-02.s.s3.explain: Leydi wuxuu leeyahay 2, dhererka iyo ballaadhka, rombona wuxuu leeyahay 2, labadiisa xariiq-dhexaad. Seddex-geesood laba-dhinac-siman wuxuu leeyahay 1 isu-dhigma-dhinac na wuxuu leeyahay 0.

x-m-el-cul-09.material: Cabbir 4/4 ah wuxuu leeyahay 4 garaac. Nooto rubuc ah waxay qaadataa 1 garaac, nooto siddeed-meel ah waxay qaadataa 0.5 garaac, nooto badh ah-na waxay qaadataa 2 garaac.
